<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אלול_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518920519_theRebbe_475" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_9C_D7_95_D7_9C_meluket__BH_POST_1766518920519_theRebbe_475__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that "Tevel" alludes to two levels of Aray, corresponding to two types of divine service in Israel—one through intellectual comprehension and one through acceptance of the yoke.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And with this will be understood what is said, "He will judge the world (Tevel) with righteousness,"</t>
    <t s="2">for, behold,</t>
    <t s="3">it is explained in Likkutei Torah52</t>
    <t s="4">that Tevel is twice Aray,</t>
    <t s="5">and this means that in the manner of the service of Aray, which is the matter of the service of love53</t>
    <t s="6">(the totality of service,</t>
    <t s="7">as per the statement54</t>
    <t s="8">"There is no worship like the worship of love"),</t>
    <t s="9">there are two levels,</t>
    <t s="10">and in general, this is the difference between Seraphim and Ofanim,</t>
    <t s="11">that the Seraphim say "Kadosh" because they comprehend how He, blessed is He, is holy and separate from the category of worlds, and therefore they desire to be included and nullified to Him, blessed is He,</t>
    <t s="12">and this is due to the reason and comprehension of the greatness of Ein Sof, blessed is He,</t>
    <t s="13">but the Ofanim are with great noise due to the absence of comprehension.</t>
    <t s="14">And likewise, these two levels exist in the souls of Israel,</t>
    <t s="15">there are those of knowledge who comprehend the greatness of the Creator, blessed is He,</t>
    <t s="16">and they desire to be included due to comprehension</t>
    <t s="17">(this being service in the aspect of sight),</t>
    <t s="18">and there is the aspect of the common people who do not comprehend at all,</t>
    <t s="19">and nevertheless they desire to be included, etc.,</t>
    <t s="20">like the analogy of the Ofanim</t>
    <t s="21">(this being service in the aspect of hearing,</t>
    <t s="22">acceptance of the yoke),</t>
    <t s="23">for every single Jew can come to the aspect of Aray.</t>
    <t s="24">And therefore it is said specifically "He will judge Tevel,"</t>
    <t s="25">for in the aspect of Tevel are hinted the two aspects in the souls of Israel.</t>
    <t s="26">And this is also what is said, "He will judge Tevel with righteousness,"</t>
    <t s="27">two [instances of] righteousness,</t>
    <t s="28">which are the two aspects of righteousness,</t>
    <t s="29">the righteousness of charity and prayer,</t>
    <t s="30">and the righteousness of Torah</t>
    <t s="31">(as above).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the concept of judgment is not merely about strict justice, but is intended to draw down a very exalted revelation, as seen in the progression from Rosh HaShanah to Sukkos.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">However, the matter of judgment</t>
    <t s="2">("He will judge Tevel with righteousness")</t>
    <t s="3">is not a matter of strict justice alone,</t>
    <t s="4">rather the intention is that through this a revelation of a most exalted light will be drawn down.</t>
    <t s="5">And the explanation of this is,</t>
    <t s="6">that the entire concept of judgment above is for the sake that through it there will be a revelation of a more exalted light,</t>
    <t s="7">and as we find regarding Rosh HaShanah and Sukkos</t>
    <t s="8">[which are hinted at in the word Aray</t>
    <t s="9">(this being the matter of Tevel,</t>
    <t s="10">twice Aray),</t>
    <t s="11">as is known55</t>
    <t s="12">that Aray is an acronym for Elul, Rosh HaShanah, Yom Kippur, Hoshana Rabbah],</t>
    <t s="13">concerning which it is said56</t>
    <t s="14">"His left hand is under my head, and His right hand embraces me,"</t>
    <t s="15">meaning,</t>
    <t s="16">that the aspect of His left, which is the judgment of Rosh HaShanah, is only for the sake of the revelation of "His right hand embraces me" on the festival of Sukkos.</t>
    <t s="17">And moreover,</t>
    <t s="18">not only is the matter of judgment for the sake that through it there will be a revelation of a more exalted light,</t>
    <t s="19">but rather, from the outset, this is not a matter of judgment at all,</t>
    <t s="20">but rather,</t>
    <t s="21">in the manner explained in the Zohar57</t>
    <t s="22">regarding the verse58</t>
    <t s="23">"The heavens are not pure in His eyes,"</t>
    <t s="24">that this matter is a virtue,</t>
    <t s="25">that because of their preciousness to Him, therefore they are not pure in His eyes,</t>
    <t s="26">like the analogy of a person who has a beautiful vessel or a beautiful building,</t>
    <t s="27">that the more precious the vessel is to him, the more he refines it, and it seems to him that it has not yet been properly refined and still needs refinement.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the judgment mentioned in the verse is from the aspect of "He" (Atik), where even judgment is a matter of mercy, being the polishing of the vessel.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is also what is said59</t>
    <t s="1">"And He will judge Tevel with righteousness,"</t>
    <t s="2">specifically "He,"</t>
    <t s="3">and it is known from the saying of our sages, of blessed memory,60</t>
    <t s="4">"Five times 'He' is for good... we have one 'He' that is better than all of them,</t>
    <t s="5">'He is the Lord our God,'61</t>
    <t s="6">whose attribute of mercy is forever."</t>
    <t s="7">And the explanation of this is,</t>
    <t s="8">behold,</t>
    <t s="9">the matter of judgment and justice is from the aspect of the Name Elokim,</t>
    <t s="10">as it is written14</t>
    <t s="11">"For the judgment is God's (Elokim's),"</t>
    <t s="12">and nevertheless it is stated here "before the Lord (Havayah), for He comes to judge."</t>
    <t s="13">But the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="14">as is known, there are62</t>
    <t s="15">two aspects of the Name Elokim,</t>
    <t s="16">the first,</t>
    <t s="17">as it is written63</t>
    <t s="18">"And you shall know... that Havayah is Elokim."</t>
    <t s="19">And the second,</t>
    <t s="20">that the Name Havayah when it ascends to Atik is considered like Elokim.</t>
    <t s="21">And this is what is said, "before Havayah, for He comes to judge,"</t>
    <t s="22">above the level of the Name Havayah,</t>
    <t s="23">and this is because the Name Havayah ascends to Atik,</t>
    <t s="24">therefore it is considered like Elokim,</t>
    <t s="25">for there is the matter of judgment and justice.</t>
    <t s="26">And this is also what is said, "And He will judge Tevel with righteousness,"</t>
    <t s="27">specifically "He,"</t>
    <t s="28">"He" is Atik,64</t>
    <t s="29">and in this aspect, behold, even judgment is a matter of mercy,</t>
    <t s="30">meaning that its matter is the polishing of the vessel.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
